emails.body_text:
Hey Doug,

I was looking at wilsonbrothersroofing.com — huge respect for years of trusted family-run residential roofing across the Denver Metro.

One mobile conversion leak caught my eye: wilsonbrothersroofing.com has zero embedded quote form on the homepage or contact page — leaving Denver homeowners with no way to preview a Class-4 hail roof range online.

Mind if I send over the live preview link?

— {{sender_name}}

It gives an honest Denver & Front Range ballpark range with a clear on-site inspection disclaimer so low-ball shoppers filter themselves out while qualified homeowners book already expecting real licensed pricing ($14,400–$19,200+).

objection_handlers.objection: We already get strong word-of-mouth referrals and repeat business.

objection_handlers.objection: Why pay $750 setup + $149/mo when we already have a website contact form?
